nodes.label: Gateway WebSocket Protocol
nodes.rationale: Defines WebSocket message protocol contract with authenticate, subscribe, unsubscribe, ping/pong, event messages and auto-subscription rules

nodes.label: Gateway Business Rules
nodes.rationale: Specifies business behavior for WebSocket connection management, auth timeout, multi-connection, online status, channel subscription, auto-subscription, and event broadcasting with Gherkin scenarios

nodes.label: Store-and-Forward Notification Model
nodes.rationale: Persist notifications to PostgreSQL before delivery attempt; WebSocket delivery is best-effort. Rejected push-only model and external event bus for v1 simplicity

nodes.label: Synchronous Event Ingestion
nodes.rationale: Emitting modules call NotificationService directly after mutations instead of async event bus. Prioritizes simplicity and transactional consistency over full decoupling for v1

nodes.label: Notification API Contract
nodes.rationale: Defines REST endpoints for list notifications, mark read, mark all read, get/update preferences, plus WebSocket notification:new and notification:read events

nodes.label: Notification Business Specification
nodes.rationale: Specifies 6 notification types, store-and-forward persistence, 90-day expiration, cursor pagination, idempotent read tracking, and best-effort WebSocket delivery

nodes.label: Notification Module Design
nodes.rationale: Hexagonal architecture for notification module with create, list, mark-read use cases, RecipientResolver per event type, and event flow from Work/Cycle modules through NotificationService to Gateway

nodes.label: Auth Cookie Migration API
nodes.rationale: Defines login, refresh, and logout endpoints with HttpOnly cookie for refresh token, Secure+SameSite=Strict flags, body fallback for backward compatibility

nodes.label: Auth Cookie Migration Business Rules
nodes.rationale: XSS mitigation via HttpOnly cookie, SameSite=Strict CSRF protection, token rotation on refresh, body fallback for transition period, cookie path scoping to /api/v1/auth/refresh

nodes.label: Cookie Migration Design
nodes.rationale: Uses @fastify/cookie plugin, cookie config helper in src/shared/cookie.ts, modifies auth controller at adapter layer without changing application use cases
